## Description
Describe the purpose of this Pull Request, what problem it solves, and which issue/Roadmap item it addresses.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (no app/feature logic altered)

## How Has This Been Tested?
Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. Provide instructions so we can reproduce.
- [ ] Test A (e.g. unit tests run and pass)
- [ ] Test B (e.g. E2E Playwright happy paths check)

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the coding style guidelines of `AGENTS.md`.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (`README.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) matching my changes.
- [ ] My changes generate no new TypeScript or Linting compilation warnings.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally.
